comparison.objective: Mount an emergency-stop button and thread its locking ring behind a panel; candidate stops before any threading operation.
comparison.physical_skill: Tab/notch alignment, panel-hole insertion, counterholding, and ring threading versus collet groove alignment and tilt/roll snap insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Button flush, tab aligned, ring advanced/turned snug, then released versus unthreaded collet retained in the nut.
comparison.reason: Candidate explicitly excludes threading; shared alignment and insertion primitives alone do not establish overlap.
